opening: I cut my head when I fell.
Three weeks ago I was in hospital with a fracture on the right side of my skull after a fall.
I take candesartan for my blood pressure.

opening.text: I had a fall and I cut my head. I feel dizzy. Three weeks ago I was in hospital with a fracture on the right side of my skull after a fall. I have high blood pressure and I take candesartan for it.
